reply:
Only two verses state kinship:

- [LiP 1,64.114] says Pulastya is the son of Brahmā ("pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ").
- [LiP 1,64.123] says the account is of the Vāsiṣṭhas and of the son of Śakti ("śaktisūnoś"). The text does not name him in that verse, so I have not named him. Parāśara is the one addressed earlier, but linking him to Śakti would be an inference. I left that out. The "Vāsiṣṭhas" form is a clan name derived from Vasiṣṭha, but the verse does not say outright that the line is named after him, so I did not list a line_of statement.
